goal: Implement adaptive exit engine, thesis re-evaluation, cost-aware opportunity rotation, and overtrading safeguards in Auto Trader BETA runner

contracts.interfaces: export interface AutoTraderRunnerConfig { assignedCapital: number; thesisReevalIntervalSeconds?: number; momentumExitThreshold?: number; momentumDropThreshold?: number; rotationThreshold?: number; minimumHoldTimeSeconds?: number; maxTradesPerHour?: number; maxRotationsPerSession?: number; expectedEdgeRatio?: number; feeRate?: number; slippageRate?: number; spreadRate?: number; }

execution_steps: Write comprehensive unit test suite in frontend/src/__tests__/auto_trader_adaptive_rotation.test.js covering dynamic ATR, thesis re-evaluation, cost-aware rotation, overtrading guards, and edge checks
Run node --test to verify red phase on new features
Update paperExecutionAdapter.ts with spread calculation and expanded exit reasons
Update autoTraderRunner.ts with adaptive ATR levels, thesis monitoring loop, cost-aware rotation engine, and extended metrics
Run node --test to verify green phase
Run npm run build and npx oxlint
Run 30-minute live paper trading session with live Binance market data and report comprehensive findings
acceptance_criteria: All new thresholds are configurable and logged explicitly
Expected edge separates Gross Profit, Fees, Slippage, Spread, and Net Edge
Thesis check exits positions upon momentum decay or regime flip to AVOID
Opportunity rotation requires score advantage >= threshold, positive net advantage after costs, and minimum hold time
Overtrading guards enforce max trades per hour and max rotations per session
All automated tests pass with exit code 0
definition_of_done: Zero private Binance API or real money endpoints are used
30-minute live paper session executes with live Binance data and outputs full comparative report

rollback.command: git checkout HEAD -- frontend/src/lib/paperExecutionAdapter.ts frontend/src/lib/autoTraderRunner.ts; rm -f frontend/src/__tests__/auto_trader_adaptive_rotation.test.js
